**Coaching explanation:**

When your opponent's pieces are poorly coordinated, look for moves that attack multiple weak points. Here, Rc7 attacks both the undefended rook and the pawn on b7. Black's rook on d7 cannot be saved—if Black plays Bxf4 (trying to create counterplay), White replies Rxd7+, winning the rook.
